description: Export the followers or following list of public TikTok profiles. No login or cookie is needed. Private accounts and hidden following lists are reported honestly.

bioKeywords.description: Only include accounts whose bio or display name contains any of these keywords. Matching is case-insensitive.
bioKeywords.title: Bio or name keywords

excludePrivate.description: Skip accounts whose profile is private.
excludePrivate.title: Exclude private accounts

includeBioEmail.description: Add a public email address from the bio when one is present. The field is omitted when the bio has no valid email.
includeBioEmail.title: Extract email from bio

includeStats.description: Add follower, following, likes received, video, likes given, and friend counts for each listed account.
includeStats.sectionDescription: Optional fields added to each row.
includeStats.title: Include audience stats

listType.description: Choose the side of the follow graph: people who follow the profile, accounts the profile follows, or both lists.
listType.title: Which list to export

maxFollowers.description: Only include accounts with at most this many followers. 0 = no maximum.
maxFollowers.title: Maximum followers

maxUsersPerProfile.description: Maximum rows to return for each requested list. Each list gets this cap. The source may return fewer when accounts are private or deleted.
maxUsersPerProfile.title: Max users per list

minFollowers.description: Only include accounts with at least this many followers. 0 = no minimum.
minFollowers.title: Minimum followers

onlyVerified.description: Only include accounts with a TikTok verified badge.
onlyVerified.sectionDescription: Optional filters applied after the list is fetched. Filtered-out rows are not pushed or charged.
onlyVerified.title: Verified accounts only

onlyWithEmail.description: Only include accounts with a public email in the bio. This also fills the bioEmail field.
onlyWithEmail.title: Only accounts with a bio email

profiles.description: TikTok usernames, @handles, or profile URLs. Paste one per line. Examples: natgeo, @sephora, https://www.tiktok.com/@tiktok.
profiles.title: TikTok profiles

scanLimit.description: Maximum list rows to scan before stopping. Use a higher value to search deeper for rare filters. 0 = automatic (10x the row cap, up to 10,000).
scanLimit.title: Scan limit

sellerOnly.description: Only include accounts marked as TikTok Shop sellers.
sellerOnly.title: TikTok Shop sellers only

title: TikTok Follow Graph & Audience Export Scraper Input
